selected_generation.p: Compare biological circuit organization and artificial feed-forward neural network, textbook conceptualillustration. Biologicalside shows TWO local neuron populations with clearly recognizable variedcellmorphologies and localrecurrentconnections plus a few long-range linksbetween populations; nobrain photographorclaimedrealconnectome. Artificialside shows clean input->hidden->output layered network, e.g3input/4hidden/2output, feed-forwardonly inthis example. Both organizations visuallybalanced; showlocalpopulationloops vs crosspopulationlinks, artificiallayersdefined. NOT number/parameter-equivalentanalogy. Planarbiologicalneuron silhouettes graceful yetminimal, lightpale semanticgroupingandwhitebackground; noiconcards. Leave names near eachgroupbutnolettering. Independentcomposition.
